name: Le Secret d'Henri 2 - Vie de Star
source:
Finding her path isn't easy for Lyla... And living a love story with a star is even harder! While her and Henri are finally together, secret-free, their relationship will be put to the test.

Between the media, the international tours, and a certain celebrity's new growing interest for Jay... Will their love survive star life?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.beemoov.secrethenri2.android]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
对于莱拉来说，找到自己的道路并不容易……而与明星的爱情故事则更难！当她和亨利最终毫无秘密地在一起时，他们的关系将受到考验。

媒体、国际巡演以及某个名人对杰伦日益增长的兴趣……他们的爱情能在明星生活中延续下去吗？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.beemoov.secrethenri2.android]Google Play[/url]]
